title: 重載鐵路軌道模數管理~Track-modulus management for heavy-haul rail
focus: 重載下支承模數辨識與載重分布~Support modulus identification and load distribution under heavy haul
summary: 重載鐵路軌道模數管理以「重載下支承模數辨識與載重分布」為主線，將十個物理或系統問題拆成機制、計算、驗證與診斷。軌道模數把每單位長度反力連到鋼軌位移，與單一扣件剛度不同；量測辨識需分離鋼軌彎曲、道碴支承及軌枕接觸。每個單元附帶可重算的假想數據與敏感度，學員需提交帶單位的工作表、可區分失效的證據及模型邊界。~This course develops support modulus identification and load distribution under heavy haul through ten physical or systems questions, each studied through mechanism, calculation, verification and diagnosis. Track modulus relates reaction per unit length to rail displacement and differs from a single fastening stiffness; identification separates rail bending, ballast support and sleeper contact. Every unit contains reproducible assumed inputs and a sensitivity calculation. Learners submit a worksheet with units, discriminating evidence for failures, and explicit model boundaries.
history: 本課把重載鐵路軌道模數管理放在可追溯的技術演進脈絡中，不把機構研究、規範出版與個別路線通車混為一談。軌道模數把每單位長度反力連到鋼軌位移，與單一扣件剛度不同；量測辨識需分離鋼軌彎曲、道碴支承及軌枕接觸。下列年代欄是工程事件、相關研究或規範出版節點；除明確標明實際工程事件者外，並非本專題設備的製造或投入營運日期。工程改進的判準是能否以量測區分假說，不能只依新舊設備外觀判斷。~The course places Track-modulus management for heavy-haul rail in a traceable engineering context and distinguishes institutional research, standards publication and the opening of individual lines. Track modulus relates reaction per unit length to rail displacement and differs from a single fastening stiffness; identification separates rail bending, ballast support and sleeper contact. The timeline identifies engineering events, relevant research and standards-publication milestones. Unless explicitly labelled as a project event, a date is not the manufacture or commissioning date of the equipment. Improvement is assessed by whether measurements distinguish hypotheses, rather than by the apparent age of machinery.
example: 以下為跨單元的原創假想工作表。先用第一單元定義邊界與單位，再以第二單元檢查另一個控制量，最後用第三單元提出前兩式未涵蓋的另一個檢查問題。原創假想算例，輸入不是現場操作值：q=100000 N/m, y=0.002 m；y=q/y/1e6=50 MN/m2。只把 q 增加百分之十，y=55 MN/m2。模型邊界：反力是每單位長度的力，位移採同一位置；假定線性均勻支承；上式只代表本單元明列項，不把它視為完整驗證。 原創假想算例，輸入不是現場操作值：k=60000000 N/m, s=0.6 m；y=k/s/1e6=100 MN/m2。只把 k 增加百分之十，y=110 MN/m2。模型邊界：離散彈簧剛度相同且等距；連續化只適用較長空間尺度；上式只代表本單元明列項，不把它視為完整驗證。把兩個算例的單一輸入敏感度放在同一張決策表，說明哪個變化最值得先量測；不可把不同物理量的裸數字直接比較，也不可把任一結果當成實際設備的設計、施工或營運許可。~This original worksheet connects the first three units using assumed inputs. Establish boundaries and units with the first unit, examine another controlling quantity with the second, and use the third to pose a separate check outside the first two equations. Original assumed example, not field operating values: q=100000 N/m, y=0.002 m; y=q/y/1e6=50 MN/m2. Increasing only q with a ten-percent increase gives y=55 MN/m2. Boundary: Reaction is force per unit length and displacement is collocated; support is linear and uniform; this equation represents only the explicitly listed term and is not a complete verification. Original assumed example, not field operating values: k=60000000 N/m, s=0.6 m; y=k/s/1e6=100 MN/m2. Increasing only k with a ten-percent increase gives y=110 MN/m2. Boundary: Discrete springs are equally stiff and spaced; homogenization applies only at longer spatial scales; this equation represents only the explicitly listed term and is not a complete verification.Put both single-input sensitivities in one decision table and explain which change most deserves measurement. Do not compare bare numbers with different physical dimensions, and do not treat any result as design approval, a construction procedure or operating permission.

units.anchor: 軌道模數定義~Track modulus definition
units.title: 軌道模數定義~Track modulus definition
units.mechanism: 單位長度反力除位移才是軌道模數。本模型把 q 當成主動改變的輸入，其餘輸入固定；當它增加百分之十，輸出增加為 55 MN/m2。這個比較描述明列方程的局部敏感度，不能把相關變數也一起改變後仍稱為相同測試。反力是每單位長度的力，位移採同一位置；假定線性均勻支承。使用反力分布與撓度作量測證據，才能檢查方程是否對應此處的實際物理量；集中剛度不能不經間距直接替代模數，因此應把該原因與量測偏差分開。~Reaction per unit length divided by displacement defines track modulus. In this model, q is deliberately changed while every other input is held fixed. A ten-percent increase means the output increases to 55 MN/m2. This comparison describes the sensitivity of the stated equation; changing correlated variables at the same time would be a different experiment. Reaction is force per unit length and displacement is collocated; support is linear and uniform. Use reaction distribution and deflection as measurement evidence that the equation represents the intended physical quantity. Lumped stiffness cannot replace modulus without spacing; separate that causal mechanism from bias in the measurement chain.
units.model: 原創假想算例，輸入不是現場操作值：q=100000 N/m, y=0.002 m；y=q/y/1e6=50 MN/m2。只把 q 增加百分之十，y=55 MN/m2。模型邊界：反力是每單位長度的力，位移採同一位置；假定線性均勻支承；上式只代表本單元明列項，不把它視為完整驗證。~Original assumed example, not field operating values: q=100000 N/m, y=0.002 m; y=q/y/1e6=50 MN/m2. Increasing only q with a ten-percent increase gives y=55 MN/m2. Boundary: Reaction is force per unit length and displacement is collocated; support is linear and uniform; this equation represents only the explicitly listed term and is not a complete verification.
units.verify: 本單元以反力分布與撓度區分模型與觀察，先用模型鋼軌分布反力、載點及鄰點撓度建立基準，再保留相同量測位置與工況重複比較。將輸入表與輸出表分開保存，記下校正、解析度及時間戳記；至少改變一個輸入並保持其餘條件，檢查結果方向是否符合「軌道模數定義」的方程。殘差超出事先設定的教學容差時，先查單位與量測鏈，再查省略的物理項。~Use reaction distribution and deflection to distinguish the model from observation in this unit. Establish a baseline using distributed model-rail reaction and deflections at and beside the load, then repeat at the same locations and conditions. Keep input and output records separate, recording calibration, resolution and timestamps. Change one input while holding others fixed and check the trend predicted by Track modulus definition. When residuals exceed a predefined teaching tolerance, examine units and the measurement chain before attributing the difference to omitted physics.
units.failure: 集中剛度不能不經間距直接替代模數。這個失效與「軌道模數定義」的量測偏差可能產生相似表象，因此必須同時檢查反力分布與撓度，不能只靠一個合成指標判定原因。若資料無法區分兩種假說，結論應保留未確定狀態，並提出下一項可推翻假說的獨立測試。~Lumped stiffness cannot replace modulus without spacing. This failure and a measurement bias in Track modulus definition can produce similar symptoms. Cross-check reaction distribution and deflection rather than diagnosing from one aggregate score. If the available observations cannot distinguish the hypotheses, retain an unresolved conclusion and specify an independent test that could falsify one explanation. Repeating the same biased sensor is not independent confirmation.
units.misconception: 本單元絕不可能出現這種失效：集中剛度不能不經間距直接替代模數~This unit cannot exhibit the following failure: Lumped stiffness cannot replace modulus without spacing.
units.practice: 重算「軌道模數定義」的基準與所列單一輸入變動案例，畫出輸入至輸出的關係，並寫出反力是每單位長度的力，位移採同一位置；假定線性均勻支承如何限制結論。接著設計一組符合模型及一組由集中剛度不能不經間距直接替代模數造成偏離的合成觀察，以反力分布與撓度說明哪個證據能分辨兩者，保留單位及有效位數。~Recalculate the baseline and specified single-input perturbation for Track modulus definition, plot the input-output relationship, and explain the limiting assumption: Reaction is force per unit length and displacement is collocated; support is linear and uniform. Construct one synthetic observation consistent with the model and another affected by this failure: Lumped stiffness cannot replace modulus without spacing. Explain which evidence in reaction distribution and deflection distinguishes them, keeping units and justified significant figures throughout.

units.title: 扣件間距換算~Fastening-spacing conversion
units.mechanism: 離散彈簧剛度除間距形成連續模數近似。本模型把 k 當成主動改變的輸入，其餘輸入固定；當它增加百分之十，輸出增加為 110 MN/m2。這個比較描述明列方程的局部敏感度，不能把相關變數也一起改變後仍稱為相同測試。離散彈簧剛度相同且等距；連續化只適用較長空間尺度。使用間距與單點剛度作量測證據，才能檢查方程是否對應此處的實際物理量；跨越懸空軌枕時均勻近似失效，因此應把該原因與量測偏差分開。~Discrete spring stiffness divided by spacing approximates continuous modulus. In this model, k is deliberately changed while every other input is held fixed. A ten-percent increase means the output increases to 110 MN/m2. This comparison describes the sensitivity of the stated equation; changing correlated variables at the same time would be a different experiment. Discrete springs are equally stiff and spaced; homogenization applies only at longer spatial scales. Use spacing and point stiffness as measurement evidence that the equation represents the intended physical quantity. Uniform approximation fails across unsupported sleepers; separate that causal mechanism from bias in the measurement chain.

units.verify: 本單元以間距與單點剛度區分模型與觀察，先用每個模型支承力位移、間距及鋼軌連續撓度建立基準，再保留相同量測位置與工況重複比較。將輸入表與輸出表分開保存，記下校正、解析度及時間戳記；至少改變一個輸入並保持其餘條件，檢查結果方向是否符合「扣件間距換算」的方程。殘差超出事先設定的教學容差時，先查單位與量測鏈，再查省略的物理項。~Use spacing and point stiffness to distinguish the model from observation in this unit. units.anchor: 梁支承特徵參數~Beam-foundation characteristic parameter
units.title: 梁支承特徵參數~Beam-foundation characteristic parameter
units.mechanism: 四次根參數連結梁彎曲剛度與分布支承。本模型把 u 當成主動改變的輸入，其餘輸入固定；當它增加百分之十，輸出增加為 1.21546 1/m。這個比較描述明列方程的局部敏感度，不能把相關變數也一起改變後仍稱為相同測試。均勻無限歐拉梁置於線性溫克勒基礎；不含剪切變形。使用沿程撓度衰減作量測證據，才能檢查方程是否對應此處的實際物理量；以集中彈簧公式替代會錯估影響長度，因此應把該原因與量測偏差分開。~A fourth-root parameter links rail bending rigidity with distributed support. In this model, u is deliberately changed while every other input is held fixed. A ten-percent increase means the output increases to 1.21546 1/m. This comparison describes the sensitivity of the stated equation; changing correlated variables at the same time would be a different experiment. Uniform infinite Euler beam on a linear Winkler foundation; shear deformation is excluded. Use longitudinal deflection decay as measurement evidence that the equation represents the intended physical quantity. A lumped-spring substitution misestimates influence length; separate that causal mechanism from bias in the measurement chain.
units.model: 原創假想算例，輸入不是現場操作值：u=50000000 N/m2, E=210000000000 Pa, I=0.00003 m4；y=(u/(4*E*I))**0.25=1.18684 1/m。只把 u 增加百分之十，y=1.21546 1/m。模型邊界：均勻無限歐拉梁置於線性溫克勒基礎；不含剪切變形；上式只代表本單元明列項，不把它視為完整驗證。~Original assumed example, not field operating values: u=50000000 N/m2, E=210000000000 Pa, I=0.00003 m4; y=(u/(4*E*I))**0.25=1.18684 1/m. Increasing only u with a ten-percent increase gives y=1.21546 1/m. Boundary: Uniform infinite Euler beam on a linear Winkler foundation; shear deformation is excluded; this equation represents only the explicitly listed term and is not a complete verification.
units.verify: 本單元以沿程撓度衰減區分模型與觀察，先用模型梁彎曲剛度、支承模數及荷載兩側撓度衰減建立基準，再保留相同量測位置與工況重複比較。將輸入表與輸出表分開保存，記下校正、解析度及時間戳記；至少改變一個輸入並保持其餘條件，檢查結果方向是否符合「梁支承特徵參數」的方程。殘差超出事先設定的教學容差時，先查單位與量測鏈，再查省略的物理項。~Use longitudinal deflection decay to distinguish the model from observation in this unit. Establish a baseline using model-beam bending rigidity, support modulus and deflection decay on both sides of the load, then repeat at the same locations and conditions. Keep input and output records separate, recording calibration, resolution and timestamps. Change one input while holding others fixed and check the trend predicted by Beam-foundation characteristic parameter. When residuals exceed a predefined teaching tolerance, examine units and the measurement chain before attributing the difference to omitted physics.
units.failure: 以集中彈簧公式替代會錯估影響長度。這個失效與「梁支承特徵參數」的量測偏差可能產生相似表象，因此必須同時檢查沿程撓度衰減，不能只靠一個合成指標判定原因。若資料無法區分兩種假說，結論應保留未確定狀態，並提出下一項可推翻假說的獨立測試。~A lumped-spring substitution misestimates influence length. This failure and a measurement bias in Beam-foundation characteristic parameter can produce similar symptoms. Cross-check longitudinal deflection decay rather than diagnosing from one aggregate score. If the available observations cannot distinguish the hypotheses, retain an unresolved conclusion and specify an independent test that could falsify one explanation. Repeating the same biased sensor is not independent confirmation.

units.practice: 重算「梁支承特徵參數」的基準與所列單一輸入變動案例，畫出輸入至輸出的關係，並寫出均勻無限歐拉梁置於線性溫克勒基礎；不含剪切變形如何限制結論。接著設計一組符合模型及一組由以集中彈簧公式替代會錯估影響長度造成偏離的合成觀察，以沿程撓度衰減說明哪個證據能分辨兩者，保留單位及有效位數。~Recalculate the baseline and specified single-input perturbation for Beam-foundation characteristic parameter, plot the input-output relationship, and explain the limiting assumption: Uniform infinite Euler beam on a linear Winkler foundation; shear deformation is excluded. Explain which evidence in longitudinal deflection decay distinguishes them, keeping units and justified significant figures throughout.

units.title: 影響長度量級~Influence-length scale
units.mechanism: 特徵參數倒數提供撓度衰減長度的量級。本模型把 beta 當成主動改變的輸入，其餘輸入固定；當它增加百分之十，輸出減少為 1.13636 m。這個比較描述明列方程的局部敏感度，不能把相關變數也一起改變後仍稱為相同測試。參數為均勻梁基礎模型的正特徵值；倒數不是反力的硬截止距離。使用荷載兩側位移作量測證據，才能檢查方程是否對應此處的實際物理量；感測範圍太短會漏掉荷載分散，因此應把該原因與量測偏差分開。~Inverse characteristic parameter gives a deflection-decay length scale. In this model, beta is deliberately changed while every other input is held fixed. A ten-percent increase means the output decreases to 1.13636 m. This comparison describes the sensitivity of the stated equation; changing correlated variables at the same time would be a different experiment. Parameter is a positive characteristic value of a uniform beam-foundation model; its inverse is not a hard reaction cutoff. Use displacements on both sides of a load as measurement evidence that the equation represents the intended physical quantity. A short sensing range misses load distribution; separate that causal mechanism from bias in the measurement chain.
units.model: 原創假想算例，輸入不是現場操作值：beta=0.8 1/m；y=1/beta=1.25 m。只把 beta 增加百分之十，y=1.13636 m。模型邊界：參數為均勻梁基礎模型的正特徵值；倒數不是反力的硬截止距離；上式只代表本單元明列項，不把它視為完整驗證。~Original assumed example, not field operating values: beta=0.8 1/m; y=1/beta=1.25 m. Increasing only beta with a ten-percent increase gives y=1.13636 m. Boundary: Parameter is a positive characteristic value of a uniform beam-foundation model; its inverse is not a hard reaction cutoff; this equation represents only the explicitly listed term and is not a complete verification.
units.verify: 本單元以荷載兩側位移區分模型與觀察，先用跨越數個特徵長度的模型位移與反力剖面建立基準，再保留相同量測位置與工況重複比較。將輸入表與輸出表分開保存，記下校正、解析度及時間戳記；至少改變一個輸入並保持其餘條件，檢查結果方向是否符合「影響長度量級」的方程。殘差超出事先設定的教學容差時，先查單位與量測鏈，再查省略的物理項。~Use displacements on both sides of a load to distinguish the model from observation in this unit. units.title: 支承區間增量剛度~Support interval incremental stiffness

units.verify: 本單元以多級載入曲線區分模型與觀察，先用多級模型力位移曲線、端點區間及加密取樣建立基準，再保留相同量測位置與工況重複比較。將輸入表與輸出表分開保存，記下校正、解析度及時間戳記；至少改變一個輸入並保持其餘條件，檢查結果方向是否符合「支承區間增量剛度」的方程。殘差超出事先設定的教學容差時，先查單位與量測鏈，再查省略的物理項。~Use multilevel loading curve to distinguish the model from observation in this unit. units.failure: 將切線與割線混用會誤判劣化。這個失效與「支承區間增量剛度」的量測偏差可能產生相似表象，因此必須同時檢查多級載入曲線，不能只靠一個合成指標判定原因。若資料無法區分兩種假說，結論應保留未確定狀態，並提出下一項可推翻假說的獨立測試。~Mixing tangent and secant stiffness misidentifies degradation. Repeating the same biased sensor is not independent confirmation.

units.anchor: 模數空間變異~Modulus spatial variation
units.title: 模數空間變異~Modulus spatial variation
units.mechanism: 變異指標須附測點間距及載重條件。本模型把 umax 當成主動改變的輸入，其餘輸入固定；當它增加百分之十，輸出增加為 0.94 1。這個比較描述明列方程的局部敏感度，不能把相關變數也一起改變後仍稱為相同測試。最大、最小及平均模數使用同一載重與測點集合；不是標準差。使用空間模數圖作量測證據，才能檢查方程是否對應此處的實際物理量；高平均模數仍可能包含軟弱局部，因此應把該原因與量測偏差分開。~Variation indices require spacing and loading conditions. In this model, umax is deliberately changed while every other input is held fixed. A ten-percent increase means the output increases to 0.94 1. This comparison describes the sensitivity of the stated equation; changing correlated variables at the same time would be a different experiment. Maximum, minimum and mean moduli use one load and point set; this is not a standard deviation. Use spatial modulus map as measurement evidence that the equation represents the intended physical quantity. A high mean modulus can still contain weak local support; separate that causal mechanism from bias in the measurement chain.
units.model: 原創假想算例，輸入不是現場操作值：umax=70 MN/m2, umin=30 MN/m2, mean=50 MN/m2；y=(umax-umin)/mean=0.8 1。只把 umax 增加百分之十，y=0.94 1。模型邊界：最大、最小及平均模數使用同一載重與測點集合；不是標準差；上式只代表本單元明列項，不把它視為完整驗證。~Original assumed example, not field operating values: umax=70 MN/m2, umin=30 MN/m2, mean=50 MN/m2; y=(umax-umin)/mean=0.8 1.
